strategy: build first outer wall on each side before starting seals; allow expedition once both have been built, even if one was subsequently destroyed
baseline_check: All three completion times equal the previous residents route measurements
limits: Perfect enemy windup information; not human response
Return distance difference is straight-line destination comparison at a local shelter choice, not measured extra production or net total travel saving
Actual total return walking spans runs of different duration and population; no direct causal efficiency claim
Crystal deltas are per-frame net observations, not gross costs or income
Wall loss is observed at minute sample points; exact destruction time not recorded
Successful export/human fun/physical-device tests not established by these runs
